⚠ Code Mode (experimental) is on · this session can be resumed only with Code Mode on

⏺ Auto mode lets Claude handle permission prompts automatically — Claude checks each tool
  call for risky actions and prompt injection before executing. Actions Claude identifies as
  safe are executed, while actions Claude identifies as risky are blocked and Claude may
  try a different approach. Ideal for long-running tasks. Claude can make mistakes that
  allow harmful commands to run, it's recommended to only use in isolated environments.
  Shift+Tab to change mode.
